title.narrative: Number of provinces for which GIS data on embankment condition and disaster vulnerability has been integrated and input into an IT-based waterways asset management system for riverbank protection
Disaster risk management and risk-sensitive land use planning are integrated into several urban plans
DRM Plans developed and urban plans updated to include disability-specific considerations and at least 3 gender-specific criteria
Studies and designs for investments with environmental and social co-benefits developed
Percentage of grievances registered related to delivery of project activities that are addressed according to agreed procedures
Number of Government staff trained in risk assessment, flood modeling, urban planning, and disaster preparedness
Participants in consultation activities during project implementation
Length of river bank protection rehabilitated in Oudomxay, Luang Prabang, and Borikhamxay
Percentage of female staff of the Project Management Unit of DOW
Number of people protected from floods
Satisfaction of weather information end-users increased
Validated hydromet data is accessible on a centralized online data management platform
Lao PDR has information and capacity to access sovereign disaster risk insurance
National disaster risk finance strategy developed
Flood risk management strategies for future urban resilience investments prepared
